newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK & Co mulls rights issue - mkt source.
newsitem.headline: SHK & Co mulls rights issue - mkt source.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd plans to raise HK$498 million through a two-for-five rights issue at HK$1.80 per rights share, market sources said on Wednesday.
"I don't know whether the issue will definitely go ahead and the details have not been finalised yet," one broker said.
Trading in Sun Hung Kai shares was suspended on Wednesday pending an announcement.
The rights share price would represent a 25 percent discount to the stock's close of HK$2.40 on Tuesday, the broker said.
Sun Hung Kai was not immediately available for comment.
One analyst said Shanghai International Securities and CEF Securities were believed to be the underwriters of the issue.
Shanghai International and CEF corporate finance officials were not immediately available for comment.
